selected_prices.rationale: Allocate $7,700 to the source model's leading projected QB in the verified BUF–BAL window. The opponent QB and fresh Buffalo availability remain unresolved; not an asserted shootout.
At $6,000, buy Detroit receiving involvement at $2,000 below St. Brown. Prior nine targets support more than a two-touchdown chase; target competition and volatility remain.
At $6,400, retain the observed lead-rushing candidate from Monday. Prior 24 carries came inside 49 team runs with 14 for Gainwell, so do not extrapolate the extreme script.

New candidate at reported $4,800. Five targets produced 115 yards, so investigate participation rather than expect that efficiency again. Mitchell returned and Wilson remains competition; no causal displacement claim.

conflicts: Fresh ESPN and official Jets notebook agree Braelon had17carries/104yards and6catches/30yards; ESPN has7targets. FantasyPros incorrectly says24carries. Its134scrimmageyards agrees, but carry claim rejected.

Official Week7 inactive list confirms Hall missed that game. Jets injury page still displays Miami, so LP/QUESTIONABLE is not new Week8 evidence. No confirmed Week8 Hall return or absence established.
Omar had5targets/5catches/115yards; Garrett3targets/2catches/26yards and Mitchell3targets/0catches. Without routes, this does not prove permanent target redistribution.
